text: 你注意到林间有些浅淡的足迹。仔细查看后，你认为它们是穿着莫卡辛鞋的人留下的。你猜那些旅行者是原住民，可能很少与贸易商接触。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 558
text: You notice light tracks through the woods. On closer examination, you think they were left by moccasin-clad humans. You guess that the travelers are Indigenous people— probably one that has had little contact with traders.
